skillDescription: The procedure for handling production incidents.

steps.description: Upon detection of a new incident, create a new incident channel in Slack.
The on-call engineer acknowledges the incident in PagerDuty.
The Incident Commander assesses the incident severity.
For major incidents, open a war room video call.
Proceed with standard investigation for non-major incidents.
All incidents required a manual ticket to be filed in Jira before March 2026.

expectedRefusals.reason: The content is conversational chatter, not a procedural step.
